additional_info.subject: RE: ID0480711-DC/Si-D/TR-[F2S4421951] Cable Quality problem CRM:02889001192
additional_info.body:
Hi Anass ,
As can be seen in the attached picture, the cable insulation has come out of the gland (raccord). Due to this condition, the cable needs to be replaced.
This appears to be a quality-related issue. The chargers were commissioned only 5 months ago, and it is not expected for the cable to deteriorate to this extent within such a short period.
We kindly ask you to review this case from a quality perspective and advise on the next steps.
With best regards,
